notes:
Mid-market SaaS vendor building in-product semantic search for enterprise customers. Initially evaluating Redwood hosted API for quick integration, but leaning toward Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation once POC passes. Key priorities: high sustained throughput for nightly batch embedding jobs (millions of docs), fast query latency for UI (95th pct < 200ms), and smooth vector DB sync (currently evaluating Pinecone and Weaviate). Cost sensitivity is moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if cost-per-embedding and per-query economics beat current managed options.

Call snippets / CRO notes: "we need nightly embed runs for 5M docs without throttling — that's the real test"; "if dedicated can give stable p95 latency and predictable cost, procurement is easier".

Integration notes: prototype uses Redis for prefix cache + Postgres metadata; wants Redwood-managed prefix/KV cache and automatic batching. Also flagged need for a connector pattern: batch export -> vector DB upsert with idempotency checks.

Security: SOC2 + SSO required; data residency for EU enterprise customers (may require dedicated nodes in eu-west).

Sales/Procurement: VP Product will run procurement review after POC report; procurement timeline target = FY Q2 (April).
